subject: Finexa - SOC 2 & pen-test evidence delivery and next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finexa.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finexa - Quick recap & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test)

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the call today — good discussion on your migration timeline and security review. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Security evidence requested: SOC 2 report (Type II), recent pen-test summary, sample audit logs, data retention policy.
- Internal owners we've mapped: Elena (security) will validate controls; Procurement will circle on contract/PO; Priya will be the economic buyer.
- Timeline: you indicated a target procurement decision by the end of June. To meet that, we should get evidence to your security team by next week.

Next steps:
1) I'll assemble the SOC 2 / pen test docs and a small audit log sample and share via secure link (ETA: 48 hours).
2) Elena — let us know if you need anything else (config details, KMS/HSM attestations, egress controls).
3) Procurement — any specific contract template / SOW details we should expect?

I'll loop in Ben (security lead) and Marissa (CS) to help with the evidence package and answers to technical Qs.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finexa.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finexa.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa - Quick recap & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test)

Thanks Dylan — that works.
A couple of clarifying items from our security team:

- SOC 2: we need the Type II report covering the last 12 months and the accompanying bridge letter if available.
- Pen test: high-level summary and remediation status for any medium/high findings.
- Audit logs: sample covering authentication events, admin actions, and data access (CSV ok) for a 30-day window.
- Data retention: a short summary showing retention default and options for custom retention per tenant.

Also, are you able to provide an ingress/egress network diagram and any details about encryption at rest (KMS provider) and in transit?

If you can get these over by Tue (May 25) we'll start the internal review and get back with any follow-ups. Thanks.

—Elena
Head of Security, Finexa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@finexa.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@finexa.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finexa - Quick recap & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test)

Elena — thanks for the detail. Looping in Ben (Security) and Marissa (CS) — they have the artifacts and can answer the remaining Qs.

Ben / Marissa — please see Elena's checklist above. Sending the initial package now via secure link; attachments below are included in the package and also copied here for quick reference:

Attachments:
- redwood_SOC2_report_v2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II, covers 2025)
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (third-party pentest summary, redacted findings)
- audit-log-sample.csv (30-day auth/admin events)

Quick answers:
- KMS: We use AWS KMS for key management; customer keys supported via bring-your-own-key in our Private offering. Details in the SOC2 report and the network diagram link.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ with certificate pinning for critical channels.
- Network diagram & retention summary: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/Finexa/Docs/FIN-48321

Ben — can you confirm the remediation status on the pen-test items and add any notes about logging granularity?

Thanks,
Dylan
